Fields.Name: Camera Target Distance
Fields.Description: Distance from the camera to the character, in metres.

Fields.Name: Rotation Range - Min X
Fields.Description: Minimum X-axis rotation

Fields.Name: Lock Rotation X - Shift Ratio
Fields.Description: How much the camera pitch shifts while locked on, 0–1.

Fields.Name: Character Origin - Offset Y
Fields.Description: Height of the camera's focus point above the character's origin, in metres.

Fields.Name: Character Lock Range - Max Radius
Fields.Description: Maximum lock-on distance, in metres.

Fields.Name: Field of View - Vertical FOV
Fields.Description: Vertical field of view, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Character Lock Range - Max Radius (Darkness)
Fields.Description: Maximum lock-on distance in darkness, in metres. Negative: use Max Radius.

Fields.Name: Character Lock Range - Max Radius (Total Darkness)
Fields.Description: Maximum lock-on distance in total darkness, in metres. Negative: use the darkness value.

Fields.Name: Melee Auto-Aim - Max Height
Fields.Description: While not locked on, how far above the attacker a target can be and still be auto-aimed by melee attacks, in metres, measured from 1.5 m above the attacker's feet.

Fields.Name: Melee Auto-Aim - Max Depth
Fields.Description: While not locked on, how far below the attacker a target can be and still be auto-aimed by melee attacks, in metres (positive value), measured from 1.5 m above the attacker's feet.

Fields.Name: Melee Auto-Aim - Angle Range
Fields.Description: While not locked on, the maximum angle between the attacker's facing and a target for melee auto-aim, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Melee Auto-Aim - Max Radius
Fields.Description: While not locked on, the maximum distance to a target for melee auto-aim, in metres (the target's own radius is added).

Fields.Name: Melee Auto-Aim - Max Radius (Darkness)
Fields.Description: Automatic lock-on judgment distance at non-lock-on _ darkness proximity

Fields.Name: Melee Auto-Aim - Max Radius (Total Darkness)
Fields.Description: Automatic lock-on when non-lock-on _ pitch black proximity

Fields.Name: Projectile Auto-Aim - Max Radius
Fields.Description: While not locked on, the maximum distance to a target for projectile auto-aim, in metres (the target's own radius is added).

Fields.Name: Projectile Auto-Aim - Max Radius (Darkness)
Fields.Description: Automatic lock-on judgment distance at non-lock-on _ darkness bullet

Fields.Name: Projectile Auto-Aim - Max Radius (Total Darkness)
Fields.Description: Automatic lock-on judgment distance at non-lock-on _ pitch black bullet

Fields.Name: Projectile Auto-Aim - Angle Range
Fields.Description: While not locked on, the maximum angle to a target for projectile auto-aim, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Lock Target Keep Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the lock-on is kept while its conditions are not met before it drops; 0 or less never keeps it. Taken from the locked target's NpcParam Lock Camera Param ID row when it has one, else row 0.

Fields.Name: Camera Follow Rate
Fields.Description: How quickly the camera follows the character's movement.
